title: Deployment test (Part B, I15-1 rules) of the I15-2 selected bias-only correction (symmetric g, nested-selected penalty lambda; full-data lambda* = 1 V); sky130 77 K, 18 devices, state C
not_done_before: any deck, compile, M2 refit or accuracy run with a lambda 1 / 2 / 0 V correction

reference_values: I15_1/deploy_v2/arrays (dense sweeps, reference gm / gds counts)

part_B.cards: M2: refit from direct43_r3_fd with full|sym_e1_l1 frozen in the loop (TRF, max_nfev 400, irls 2, diff_step 0.01, state C)
core: Q3 0 circuits failing only with the element
restrictions: >= 1 gds curve (of 90) with an introduced sign change
part_B.label: any core fail -> not deployable; core pass and >= 1 restriction -> deployable with restrictions; else deployable (simulator-level)
part_B.amendment_A1_of_I12_1: applies (circuit runtime ratio over circuits where M2_card and M2_full pass; no repeats after a failed run)
part_B.q1_runs_scope: every element deck: grids (serpentine), AC, dense; grid row count != 11175 counts as a failed run
part_B.expectation_not_rule: more than 2 of 90 gds curves with an introduced sign change (full-data negative gds on the penalty grids 1.59 % at lambda 1 V vs 0.23 % at 10 V)

restriction_items_reported: Q1 max relative difference at |I_py| > 1 nA per device, default / r4 / tight
gds per device and V(g,s) (0.6, 0.9, 1.2, 1.5, 1.85 V): introduced flag; dense-sweep points with dI/dV(d,s) < 0 at |V(d,s)| >= 0.05 V for element, card, I_card exp(g); V(d,s) range; g range

gm per device and V(d,s) (0.05, 0.925, 1.85 V): introduced flag (core); dense-sweep points with dI/dV(g,s) < 0 in strong inversion (|V(g,s)| >= V_T + 0.2 V) and over the sweep for element, card, I_card exp(g)
same gds / gm counts for the I15-1 g v2 arm from stored arrays (reference)
runtime: grid and circuit ratios; ro5_A decomposition on I16-1 M2 cards

fixed_from_I15_2.outcome: selected variant non-inferior to M_bias v1

accuracy.element_deck: reported, no rule: element-deck, Python rerun and channel-model Python RRMS of the 18 selected held-out pairs; differences to I15-2 selected_rows; all-device / combined / median; GMR(element selected, v1 stored), GMR(element selected, C0_refit), GMR(element selected, I15-1 element g v2)

validity.V1: card-only library deck x exp(fold g) of the 18 selected held-out pairs reproduces I15-2 selected_rows: max |diff| <= 1e-9
validity.V2: unit tests of I15-1 plus tests.test_i15_2_ablate and tests.test_i16_1_sel pass
validity.V3: 18 element-deck accuracy rows; 0 failed M2 refits
validity.V4: deployed g: inputs sym_v2, eps 0.01, lambda 1.0 in lodo_sym_e1_l1/results.json; I15-2 lambda_star.full == 1.0

decision.invalid: any validity fail -> stop: fix and re-register
decision.deployable: all Part B core checks pass (label 'deployable with restrictions' or 'deployable (simulator-level)'; restrictions listed) -> the I15-2 selected variant is the deployable add-on candidate; report restrictions
decision.not deployable: any core check fails -> stop; diagnose the failed core checks

order: prereg commit (alone) -> code + unit tests commit -> smoke (nmos_L1_W1p6, pmos_L2_W5, refit max_nfev 20) -> queue: I16_1_validity, I16_1_accuracy, I16_1_deploy, I16_1_restrict, I16_1_runtime, I16_1_decide
